title: Segment Anything Model for Road Network Graph Extraction
mechanism: Fine-tuned SAM encoder predicts vertex and intersection masks, NMS gives vertices, a small transformer predicts edges, giving a vector graph.
adaptation: Severity, not IoU: a crack graph per cell gives crack mode (single line, dendritic, cross) and length; benchmark severity track.
min_experiment: Arm = SAM-Road style graph head on crack; baseline = skeletonised PF prediction; metric graph APLS / crack-mode accuracy vs label skeleton graph on CV. Kill if not better than skeletonised PF.
evidence: R: comparable to RNGDet++ on City-scale, 40x faster.

alt_notes.adaptation: Severity track only: crack graph per cell gives crack mode (single line, cross, dendritic), length and branch count; train on skeleton graphs from crack labels.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Graph extraction on CV folds; metric crack-mode agreement with labels-derived graphs; no score kill line (severity feature).
